tinker.name: Archive
tinker.description: View, extract, and create archive files

zh-CN.name: 压缩包
zh-CN.description: 查看、解压和创建压缩包

open.description: Open a ZIP archive for viewing and editing. Call this before list/add/mkdir/delete/extract. Returns the archive path and root entries.

create.description: Create a new empty ZIP archive at the given path and open it. Same as creating an archive in the UI.

path.description: Absolute path for the new .zip file. A .zip extension is added if missing.

list.description: List entries in the open archive. Optionally navigate to a directory inside the archive first. Call open or create first.

path.description: Directory path inside the archive (use '' or omit for root / current directory). Directories should end with '/'.

add.description: Add local files or folders into the open archive. Call open or create first. Changes are saved to the ZIP immediately.

paths.description: Absolute local file or folder paths to add

dest.description: Destination directory inside the archive. Defaults to the current directory.

mkdir.description: Create a folder inside the open archive. Call open or create first. Changes are saved immediately.

path.description: Folder path inside the archive (e.g. 'docs/' or 'a/b/'). A trailing slash is added if missing.

delete.description: Delete files or folders from the open archive by their entry paths. Call open or create first. Folder paths should end with '/'. Changes are saved immediately.

paths.description: Entry paths inside the archive to delete

extract.description: Extract entries from the open archive to a local directory. Omit paths to extract the entire archive. Call open or create first.

dest.description: Absolute local directory to extract into

paths.description: Entry paths inside the archive to extract. Omit to extract everything.
